title: Declare every theme in the repository's plan/_themes.yaml

facts.note: Plan artifacts (wagons, trains, interlockings, contracts) and the theme registry live under plan/. Touching or validating plan/_themes.yaml alone activates the rule.
Artifact kinds that carry a theme field, plus the registry itself (registry-only edits and validation are in scope).
Authoring, editing, or validating the plan or the registry.

values: registry entry added, renamed, reordered, or removed
facts.note: Optional trigger only: a diff-level observer for theme and registry edits. The invariant also applies to unchanged artifacts and an unchanged registry.

values: planner.theme.must-be-canonical: index 0 occupied by a name other than commons
facts.note: Findings from the planner static validator (planner.static.validators.bun) or a registry-shape observer that parses plan/_themes.yaml. The index-0 check is a reservation: it fires only when index 0 is populated with a name other than commons; an empty registry (no index 0) is not a reservation violation, and the source does not require a commons entry to exist.

fires: A planner authors a new wagon, train, interlocking, or contract and sets its theme.
A planner changes the theme of an existing plan artifact.
A planner renames or removes an entry in plan/_themes.yaml that artifacts still reference.
The plan is validated and an existing, unchanged artifact references a theme not declared in plan/_themes.yaml.
A plan uses a theme name assumed to come from a package default taxonomy that is not declared in plan/_themes.yaml.
A planner edits or validates plan/_themes.yaml (even with no themed artifact touched) and the registry contains a non-kebab-case name.
A planner edits or validates plan/_themes.yaml and index 0 is populated with a name other than commons (e.g. after reordering, the resulting registry has another name at index 0).
Every artifact theme resolves, but the registry itself violates the kebab-case naming rule or the index-0 reservation for commons.
doesNotFire: Plan validation or edits where every theme on every wagon, train, interlocking, and contract resolves to a value in plan/_themes.yaml, all registry names are kebab-case, and index 0 is either commons or unpopulated.
Code-only changes outside plan/ that neither touch plan/_themes.yaml nor reference wagon/train/interlocking/contract themes.
Adding a new kebab-case theme to plan/_themes.yaml at a nonzero index, with index 0 untouched and no artifact referencing an undeclared theme.

given: A plan has plan/_themes.yaml and/or wagons, trains, interlockings, or contracts with a theme (new, changed, or unchanged); registry-only work included.
when: The planner authors, edits, or validates a themed plan artifact or the registry.
then: Every wagon, train, interlocking, and contract theme MUST resolve to a value in the repository-owned plan/_themes.yaml registry.
prefer: Declare themes in plan/_themes.yaml with any kebab-case name.
Keep index 0 reserved for commons: if index 0 is populated, its name is commons.
Treat an unresolved theme as a plan error; fix the registry or the artifact.
Check all of: index 0, if populated, is commons; names are kebab-case; every artifact theme resolves. Resolution alone is not compliance.
avoid: Relying on a package default taxonomy; none exists, and no game or toolkit vocabulary is supplied.
Expecting a package-default lookup to resolve an undeclared theme.
Any name other than commons at index 0.
why: Themes are repository-owned with no package fallback, so an undeclared theme is a plan error. Downstream naming and boundary rules presuppose a resolvable theme.
evidence: Every theme on wagons, trains, interlockings, and contracts (new or existing) appears as a value in plan/_themes.yaml (canonical_resolution).
In plan/_themes.yaml, index 0, if populated, is commons, and all names are kebab-case; checked even when no artifact changed and all references resolve.
The planner static validator (planner.static.validators.bun) reports no planner.theme.must-be-canonical findings.
verifier_detail: Term canonical_resolution: a theme resolving to a value in plan/_themes.yaml. values: source=plan/_themes.yaml; package_defaults=none; consumer_repo=declares its own names.
Do not fall back to any package-default theme list; an undeclared theme is a plan error, not a package-default lookup.
Scope: themes on all wagon, train, interlocking, and contract artifacts in the plan, not only changed ones.

Registry names: any kebab-case name, except index 0 is reserved for commons. Reservation semantics: a finding only when index 0 is populated with a name other than commons; do not require that index 0 be populated or that a commons entry exist; evaluate the resulting registry after reorders rather than flagging the move itself. Check registry shape independently of reference resolution.
